excluded_observations.what: 31% yield, 1 equiv FeCl2, 100 °C, after 20 min light then 20 min dark
excluded_observations.why: Not a single condition set: the gain from 18% to 31% happened in the dark period after the light was switched off (mixed on/off protocol, Figure 2c/Table S8).
